body.objective: Decide whether the Einstein, scalaron/topological and cosmological scales of the selected compensator repair are introduced parameters, gauge-chart conventions, genuine order parameters or quantum-generated scales.
body.stop_condition: Import the A/B selection, the selected Einstein/extra/charge exact sequence and the selected-action regulator by exact hashes. Write the renormalized effective action in g_hat variables with every independent finite normalization and beta function. Prove which combinations are gauge invariant and scheme independent, whether f is only a polar-chart input, whether any nonzero scale is generated by dimensional transmutation or a stationary effective potential, and whether the selected vacuum is a local minimum in the complete reduced scalar/topological sector. For Candidate A include the scalaron mass and its running; for Candidate B include the cosmological/flux integration constant and its superselection status. Emit an exact scale-origin ledger and independent RG/effective-potential or no-definition rail.
body.current_gate: origin and physical status of scales in the selected changed theory
body.forbid: no rho=f gauge choice called spontaneous breaking; no introduced f called generated; no beta function without the selected regulator and counterterm basis; no effective-potential extremum called stable without the reduced Hessian; no low-energy GR, phenomenology, dark-sector, particle or unitarity claim
activates: or an exact proof that all current scales remain external/scheme-dependent
body.resource_hint: POST-SELECTION QUANTUM GATE. This replaces the old scale-generation item tied to the retired naive compensator parent.
notes: The classical preflight already proves that f is introduced and rho=f is a gauge chart.
A generated scale must be demonstrated in invariant dressed variables.
